notes: The page begins with the literal continuation fragment phisme évident, then states surjectivity of a displayed tame fundamental-group homomorphism. A proof reduces connectedness of a covering on the selected geometric fibre to generic connectedness, using claimed relative purity and tame specialization. These are document claims, not results verified in this reading.

The proof ends with the prospective wording qui figure(ra) dans SGA 1 XIII (exposé de Mme Raynaud). This wording is not itself an explicit admission of an unverified proof step. Remarque 7 begins a Lefschetz-pencil application using SGA 7 XVIII and statement 6; its continuation is outside this page and has not been supplied.
No independent title, author's own page number, date, or stated total page count appears. The lower-left archive number is 114 and is recorded as a comment.

Literal visible slips and unusual forms retained include enx vertu, grassmanienne, figure(ra), a grave over the mixed m-position of croisements, Remarque7.Avec without the blank cells supplied by H, and the opening fragment phisme. The mixed covering-variable, engisagée/envisagée, codimension, compte, and final par/per cells remain explicitly qualified.

The cancelled tel que sa includes a readable final comma. The right-edge cancelled famille is only visibly famill; no terminal e has been supplied. The final cancellation starts on the s of des and ends in a downturned cancellation stroke, not a separately visible typed hyphen.

The raised parameter-space text is un voisinage ouvert assez petit T de and is anchored before la grassmanienne. H's dans and barred t are not present. A separate raised cancelled T remains after grassmanienne.

All settled agreements between C and H were checked against the original halves. A single crop clarified that the underline under surjectif is one broad stroke; a separate crop retained maximale because no unlike-letter contour was recovered. Those inspections did not create difference rows.

Mathematical content was used only to locate the relevant symbols. No expected name, spelling, theorem, or geometric argument was used to settle an ambiguous glyph. No genuine proof check or independent re-proof was performed; checks is therefore empty.

H's emphasis on Démonstration is treated as editorial heading formatting; the ink has no underline there. Equivalent emphasis/state/technique macro syntax alone is excluded from the differences. The archive number equivalence is also not counted as a difference.

The supplied notation snapshot and this scan's prior-question file were read as nonbinding prompts for inspection. No other page, reader output, external source, OCR, recognition library, or agent was consulted.

The whole image was displayed once for layout, each original half once, and each of the 15 saved local crops once. No decided image was reopened and no crop was remade. Faint show-through was not treated as additional face text.

The opening marginal stroke and the two points near t-prime are reproduced without assigning their material, maker, or textual purpose. The two points remain inline below-left of t-prime rather than being moved to a separate centered figure.
